gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all field configurations to understand how fields are organized across different projects.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all field configurations available in the Jira instance.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to create a new field configuration to customize the fields for a specific project.
gold.ideal: Creates a new field configuration and returns the details of the created configuration.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to delete an obsolete field configuration to clean up the system.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified field configuration and confirms the deletion.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update an existing field configuration to modify field settings based on user feedback.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified field configuration and returns the updated configuration details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to see all fields associated with a specific field configuration to understand its structure.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of fields associated with the specified field configuration.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to update the fields in a field configuration to better align with project requirements.
gold.ideal: Updates the fields in the specified field configuration and returns the updated list of fields.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all field configuration schemes to see how they are applied to different projects.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all field configuration schemes in the Jira instance.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to create a new field configuration scheme to apply specific configurations to a set of projects.
gold.ideal: Creates a new field configuration scheme and returns its details.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to see the mappings of field configuration schemes to understand their application.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of mappings between field configuration schemes and projects.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the project mapping for field configuration schemes to ensure proper configuration.
gold.ideal: Returns the project mapping for field configuration schemes.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to assign a field configuration scheme to a project to apply specific field settings.
gold.ideal: Assigns the specified field configuration scheme to the project and confirms the assignment.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to delete an unused field configuration scheme to maintain system organization.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified field configuration scheme and confirms the deletion.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update a field configuration scheme to reflect changes in project requirements.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified field configuration scheme and returns the updated details.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to set the mapping for a field configuration scheme to ensure it applies to the correct projects.
gold.ideal: Sets the mapping for the specified field configuration scheme and confirms the update.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to remove specific issue types from a global field configuration scheme to refine its application.
gold.ideal: Removes the specified issue types from the global field configuration scheme and confirms the removal.
